name: SPT Energy Group Inc.
summary: SPT Energy Group Inc., an investment holding enterprise, offers a full spectrum of integrated oilfield services and manufactures related products for a global clientele. Its operational reach extends across the People's Republic of China, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Canada, Singapore, Indonesia, the Middle East, and numerous other international markets. The company structures its business into three main divisions: Drilling, Well Completion, and Reservoir services. In the Drilling segment, SPT Energy provides a wide array of offerings, including the deployment of drilling and workover rigs, specialized complex well workover and fishing operations, and essential cementing and drilling fluid services. Furthermore, it leverages advanced drilling technologies such as rotary geosteering, vertical and horizontal drilling, side-tracking, underbalanced drilling, and precision managed pressure drilling. Its Well Completion division is dedicated to designing completion projects, supplying vital well completion tools, and executing stimulation and fracturing services. The Reservoir segment encompasses comprehensive geological and oil reservoir research, dynamic monitoring, oil testing, and enhanced recovery technologies. It also provides coiled tubing services and maintains surface production equipment. Beyond its core oilfield activities, SPT Energy Group diversifies its interests into farming, trading, manufacturing, the promotion of technological applications, and the provision of gas operation and related services. Established in 1993, SPT Energy Group Inc. maintains its headquarters in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
